placements.why: The envelope's entire content is a technology-selection decision (database/analytics pipeline) with a stated performance justification and rollout timeline. No strata exists yet in this repo, and nothing named here covers organizational-strategy categories like technical/infrastructure decisions — this is the first content of that kind, so it mints the foundational category rather than nesting under something not yet present.
placements.title: systems and infrastructure choices entering the organizational record
placements.frame: What technical system, tool, or infrastructure component is being chosen, and what capability or performance ground justifies it?

placements.title: technology choices ratified on quantified performance grounds
placements.frame: What system or tool is being adopted, what quantified performance claim is offered as its justification, and what timeline commits the organization to it?
placements.why: src-1 is the source declarative naming the tool (Zypherion), the performance rationale (15x faster columnar queries), and the migration timing in one triadic statement — a subject future technology-decision envelopes will keep feeding, not a one-time fact. src-2, src-3, and src-4 restate the same three facts as compressed bold-label entries produced by the same animator with no principal attributed; per the grain rule these are evidence for the adoption theme rather than leaves of their own (the tool name, the 15x figure, and the Q3 2026 date are measurements/facts, not standalone subjects). No existing narrative leaf or strata sub-area was available to reuse (both supplied as empty), so this mints fresh under the newly-minted Architecture strata as an EXACT parent fit.
